description: Probe catalog for China Mobile Cloud Drive.

probe_items.goal: Capture a reusable logged-in mobile cloud session including token and cookie context.
notes: Implemented by mobile_capture_current_session and mobile_capture_current_session_from_logged_in_page browser flows.

probe_items.goal: Identify the stable root listing endpoint and its pagination contract.
notes: Current stable native capability is file_list in config/provider-capabilities/mobile-native.json.

probe_items.goal: Identify the endpoint that exposes total and used capacity.
notes: Provider-mobile uses getPersonalDiskInfo and getFamilyDiskInfo for capacity facts; family object mapping still requires a real family_root_folder_id.

probe_items.goal: Identify how a listed file is converted into a real download URL or stream request.
notes: Provider-mobile resolves listed fileId values through file_get_download_url.

probe_items.goal: Discover stable create/delete/rename/copy/move/upload request paths for future native or hybrid writes.
notes: file_create, file_complete, file_update, file_batch_delete, and file_batch_move are cataloged; file_batch_copy remains capability-gated until a real stable endpoint/shape is confirmed.
